'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Thomas Whaley LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whaley]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Some old BS.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Whaley]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|Mind What You Have Learned]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
